examples.why: The stored Arabic was a translation of this other paragraph on the same page: «If you took the QFT of the state $\psi = |0\rangle - |N/2\rangle$, then you would see peaks on every odd binary numbered state. »

editor_note: Not drift. check-known-mistranslations flagged a prefix left detached by a tatweel before Arabic text (لـ استخدم). Rephrased to «اختبار الشارة لدورة "استخدم حاسوبًا كموميًا اليوم"», attaching the prefix to a noun. The tatweel form before a LATIN-script name elsewhere on the page (لـ IBM) is correct Arabic typography and was deliberately left alone — clearing the checker by changing both would have introduced a defect.
